'''Nukss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal who was affiliated with [[the Scourge]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he was present in [[Yellowblade's Landing]] when [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] arrived. After the brothers mistook them for potential gang members, Maul and Savage killed Nukss' entire entourage, including Nukss himself.
